title: I canceled my Google AI Pro plan after 6 months; here's what went wrong
excerpt: The value disappeared faster than expected
content_html:
Published Aug 11, 2026, 8:16 AM EDT

Parth is a technology analyst and writer specializing in the comprehensive review and feature exploration of the Android ecosystem. His work focus on productivity apps and flagship devices, particularly Google Pixel and Samsung mobile hardware and software.

He provides expert guidance on productivity software, system optimization, and the advanced functionalities that allow users to maximize their device's potential. His analyses are crucial resources for readers seeking to master complex operating system features and streamline their digital workflows.

When he is not busy with technical analysis and software evaluation, Parth dedicates his time to watching K-dramas, studying mobile technology trends and the role of artificial intelligence.

I gave Google AI Pro a fair shot for six months because, on paper, it looked like one of the most complete AI subscriptions around.

Gemini was at the center of it, but Google also bundled Antigravity, AI features across its ecosystem, Google Health AI Premium, and even YouTube Premium Lite.

However, the cracks became harder to ignore. Several features I was excited about barely made a difference, and I found myself reaching for other AI tools.

Gemini never became my best AI assistant

This was the deal breaker

This was easily the biggest problem I had with Google AI Pro. I can overlook a weak bundle perk or an integration I rarely use, but I can’t overlook the main AI assistant failing to fit into my everyday workflow.

After six months, Gemini still never became the first tool I opened when I needed help refining an idea, writing an email, or working through something complicated.

More often than not, I ended up opening ChatGPT. The biggest issue was the quality and style of Gemini’s responses.

I frequently found them robotic, overly structured, and wordier than needed.

Even when Gemini understood what I was asking, the final response often required another round of editing before I could actually use it.

Gemini 3.6 Flash has its strengths. It is fast, responsive, and perfectly capable of handling prompts. But speed only gets me so far.

When I compare its output with GPT-5.6 or Fable 5 on more nuanced tasks, I still notice a gap.

When I am paying for an AI subscription and using it throughout my workday, those small annoyances add up quickly.

This is what pushed me toward canceling Google AI Pro. I already have alternatives that work better for the tasks I care about most.

ChatGPT has become my default for brainstorming, writing, research, and general problem-solving, while Claude remains my preferred tool for coding and Cowork capabilities.

More importantly, I spend less time fixing their output afterward.

I could overlook Google AI Pro’s other issues if Gemini were solid enough for my daily tasks.

But when the main product is the one I keep choosing not to use in favor of competitors, it becomes hard to justify paying it every month.

Antigravity never became a serious alternative

Cursor fits my needs better

Antigravity was another Google AI Pro perk that sounded more useful to me than it actually turned out to be.

I gave it a fair shot for my coding projects, but it never pulled me away from Cursor.

Antigravity still feels somewhat basic, especially when I want to move quickly between planning, making changes, and refining a project.

Cursor fits the way I work better, and its overall agentic workflow feels more polished and practical for my needs.

I already have a coding environment that I am comfortable with, so Antigravity never became compelling enough to add meaningful value to my Google AI Pro subscription.

Google Health AI Premium lost its appeal

My Fitbit Air experience changed the equation

Google Health AI Premium could have been another reason for me to stick with Google AI Pro.

I tried using it with my Fitbit Air. But my recent experience with Google’s latest wearable left me disappointed.

During a roughly five-hour drive, the tracker somehow recorded thousands of steps even though I was sitting behind the wheel for almost the entire journey.

Due to this, I am now considering switching to Samsung Health. It also means the Google Health AI Premium perk no longer gives me much reason to keep Google AI Pro.

Gemini doesn’t work with many third-party services

Unlike ChatGPT and Claude

Another issue I kept running into with Gemini was its limited third-party app support.

Gemini works well when I stay inside Google’s ecosystem, and integrations with services like WhatsApp and Canva help.

But my day-to-day workflow extends beyond Google apps, and that is where Gemini starts feeling restrictive.

I regularly use tools like Asana and Figma for work, and ChatGPT fits much better into that setup because it can connect with a range of third-party services.

That flexibility matters more to me than having deep integration with Gmail, Drive, or Calendar.

If I am paying for a premium assistant, I want it to sit across my entire workflow, not only one part of it.

I kept paying, barely using it

Canceling Google AI Pro after six months does not mean I am done with Gemini for good.

ChatGPT and Claude fit my workflow better. Antigravity has not become essential, and most of the bundled extras either overlap with services I already pay for or no longer interest me.

That said, I am looking forward to Gemini 3.5 Pro and what Google does next.

If the new model can close the gap with GPT-5.6 and Fable 5, I will happily give Google AI Pro another shot in the future.

content_html_zh:
发布于 2026 年 8 月 11 日，美国东部时间上午 8:16

Parth 是一位技术分析师和作家，专门从事 Android 生态系统的全面回顾和功能探索。 他的工作重点是生产力应用程序和旗舰设备，特别是 Google Pixel 和三星移动硬件和软件。

他提供有关生产力软件、系统优化和高级功能的专家指导，使用户能够最大限度地发挥其设备的潜力。 他的分析对于寻求掌握复杂操作系统功能并简化数字工作流程的读者来说是至关重要的资源。

当他不忙于技术分析和软件评估时，帕斯会花时间观看韩剧、研究移动技术趋势和人工智能的作用。

我给了 Google AI Pro 六个月的公平机会，因为从纸面上看，它看起来像是周围最完整的 AI 订阅之一。

Gemini 是其中的核心，但谷歌还在其生态系统中捆绑了反重力、人工智能功能、Google Health AI Premium，甚至 YouTube Premium Lite。

然而，裂缝变得更难以忽视。 我感到兴奋的几个功能几乎没有带来什么影响，我发现自己开始寻求其他人工智能工具。

Gemini 从未成为我最好的 AI 助手

这是交易破坏者

这无疑是我在使用 Google AI Pro 时遇到的最大问题。 我可以忽略一个较弱的捆绑福利或我很少使用的集成，但我不能忽视主要的人工智能助手无法融入我的日常工作流程。

六个月后，当我需要帮助完善想法、写电子邮件或解决复杂问题时，Gemini 仍然没有成为我打开的第一个工具。

通常，我最终会打开 ChatGPT。 最大的问题是双子座回应的质量和风格。

我经常发现它们机械化、过于结构化并且比需要的更加冗长。

即使双子座理解了我的要求，最终的答复也常常需要另一轮编辑才能真正使用。

Gemini 3.6 Flash有它的优点。 它速度快、反应灵敏，并且能够完美地处理提示。 但速度只能让我到目前为止。

当我在更细致的任务上将其输出与 GPT-5.6 或 Fable 5 进行比较时，我仍然注意到了差距。

当我付费订阅人工智能并在整个工作日使用它时，这些小烦恼很快就会累积起来。

这就是促使我取消 Google AI Pro 的原因。 我已经有了更适合我最关心的任务的替代方案。

ChatGPT 已成为我集思广益、写作、研究和解决一般问题的默认工具，而 Claude 仍然是我用于编码和协作功能的首选工具。

更重要的是，我之后花更少的时间来修复他们的输出。

如果 Gemini 足够坚固来完成我的日常任务，我可以忽略 Google AI Pro 的其他问题。

但是，当我一直选择不使用主要产品以支持竞争对手时，就很难证明每个月支付费用是合理的。

反重力从未成为一个严肃的选择

光标更适合我的需求

反重力是 Google AI Pro 的另一项福利，对我来说听起来比实际更有用。

我在我的编码项目中给予了它公平的机会，但它从未让我远离 Cursor。

反重力感觉仍然有些基础，尤其是当我想在计划、更改和完善项目之间快速移动时。

Cursor 更适合我的工作方式，而且它的整体代理工作流程感觉更精致、更实用，更能满足我的需求。

我已经有了一个令我满意的编码环境，因此反重力从未变得足够引人注目，无法为我的 Google AI Pro 订阅添加有意义的价值。

Google Health AI Premium 失去吸引力

我的 Fitbit Air 体验改变了一切

Google Health AI Premium 可能是我坚持使用 Google AI Pro 的另一个原因。

我尝试将其与 Fitbit Air 一起使用。 但我最近对谷歌最新可穿戴设备的体验让我感到失望。

在大约五个小时的车程中，追踪器以某种方式记录了数千步，尽管我几乎整个旅程都坐在方向盘后面。

因此，我现在正在考虑转用三星健康。 这也意味着 Google Health AI Premium 福利不再给我太多理由保留 Google AI Pro。

Gemini 无法与许多第三方服务配合使用

与 ChatGPT 和 Claude 不同

我在使用 Gemini 时经常遇到的另一个问题是其有限的第三方应用程序支持。

当我留在 Google 的生态系统中时，Gemini 运作良好，与 WhatsApp 和 Canva 等服务的集成也很有帮助。

但我的日常工作流程超出了 Google 应用程序的范围，这就是 Gemini 开始感到受到限制的地方。

我经常在工作中使用 Asana 和 Figma 等工具，而 ChatGPT 更适合这种设置，因为它可以与一系列第三方服务连接。

对我来说，这种灵活性比与 Gmail、云端硬盘或日历的深度集成更重要。

如果我付费购买高级助手，我希望它贯穿我的整个工作流程，而不仅仅是其中的一部分。

我一直付费，几乎没有使用它

六个月后取消 Google AI Pro 并不意味着我永远不再使用 Gemini。

ChatGPT 和 Claude 更适合我的工作流程。 反重力还没有变得必不可少，大多数捆绑的附加服务要么与我已经付费的服务重叠，要么不再让我感兴趣。

也就是说，我很期待 Gemini 3.5 Pro 以及谷歌接下来会做什么。

如果新模型能够缩小与 GPT-5.6 和 Fable 5 的差距，我很乐意在未来再给 Google AI Pro 一次机会。
